samples.question: A pale sheet shows two small light grey panels far apart, one on the left and one on the right, with empty sheet between them. The left panel holds four solid dark navy bars and the right panel holds three, all of the same thickness. The bars do not share a common left edge, so measure each bar only by its own length from its own left end to its own right end. Three of the four left bars have exactly one right bar of exactly the same length, and every right bar is used by exactly one of them; exactly one left bar has no right bar of its length. The unpaired left bar is neither the longest nor the shortest bar in the left panel. All four left bars have different lengths. Vertical position, thickness, left edge position, and the pale coloured decoration outside the panels carry no information. Numbering the left-panel bars 1, 2, 3, 4 from the top downwards, which numbered left bar has no equal-length partner in the right panel? Answer with one digit.
